messages:
Maya P: Heads-up-- cloud marketplace asked for firmware attestation + vendor security questionnaire (v3.2) before we can publish the HW+SI bundle. Also want evidence of vulnerability scan and proof of secure update channel. Who owns what?
Tom G: I can pick up the questionnaire (v3.2). Ill map answers to our SOC2 controls where possible and flag gaps. Will need Raj to confirm firmware signing process.
Raj (HW): Firmware team confirms UEFI secure boot + HSM-based signing for images. We can produce an attestation letter and a signed hash list. Need to know acceptable format for marketplace.
SI-Liaison: Marketplace prefers either a PDF attestation letter + a machine-readable manifest (JSON) of firmware hashes. Also they want dates of last firmware release and rolling update cadence.
Maya P: Action item: attestation letter + manifest + questionnaire answers + vuln scan report. Also marketplace wants to see pen-test scope doc (not full report) for triage.
Tom G: For the questionnaire, two tricky Qs: 4.7 (third-party components) and 6.2 (secure update). Tom G:@Raj can you confirm SBOM level (full transitive vs direct deps)? If we provide SPDX for direct + top-10 transitive, is that ok?
Raj (HW): We can generate SPDX for direct deps now, transitive would take 3-4 days to assemble. Offer SPDX_direct + summary_transitive seems reasonable.
LegalBot: Reminder: any attestation or manifest must be reviewed by legal before external release. Use the template in /legal/marketplace/attest-template-v1.docx.
OpsBot: Created Google Cloud Storage path: gs://redwood-marketplace-evidence/partners/hw-si-456/. Default signed URL TTL = 72h. Use upload-policy for larger artefacts.
Maya P: Example signed URL command for partners (gcloud):
```
gsutil signurl -d 72h /path/to/key.json gs://redwood-marketplace-evidence/partners/hw-si-456/firmware-manifest.json
```
Tom G: For vulnerability evidence: we should upload non-sensitive scan summary + CVE metadata; redact any customer IPs. Ill produce a redaction matrix that maps "sensitive" -> owner.
SI-Liaison: For pen-test, marketplace accepts a pen-test attestation letter plus an ATO summary. They only require the full report for private review in some cases. We should ask provider what sensitive data will be in findings.
Raj (HW): Pen-test scope: network + firmware OTA endpoint + admin portal. Vendor says theyll avoid customer data in their findings by default but might include sample config snippets.
Tom G: I'll draft questionnaire answers and the redaction matrix by Apr 6. Raj aims to deliver firmware manifest + attestation by Apr 8. Pen-test attestation expected Apr 12, full report held in secure bucket.
Maya P: Decision: publish checklist in listing metadata noting "firmware attestation provided, pen-test attestation pending full report; full report available to marketplace reviewers on request" if timelines slip. OpsBot: please tag listing status field.
OpsBot: Listing metadata tag updated: {"firmware_attestation":"provided","pen_test":"attestation_pending"} (internal).
LegalBot: Also confirm that attestation language includes no admissions of vulnerability and follows approved phrasing. Ill review first draft within 48h.
Tom G: Upload plan: 1) questionnaire_answers_v3.2.pdf (redacted) 2) firmware_attestation_signed.pdf 3) firmware_manifest.json 4) vuln_scan_summary_redacted.pdf 5) pen_test_attestation.pdf (when available). All go to gs://redwood-marketplace-evidence/partners/hw-si-456/ with 72h signed links.
Maya P: Quick sync Friday 09:30 to verify artifacts and legal sign-off. If anyone blocks earlier, flag here and OpsBot will reassign presign TTLs.
OpsBot: Calendar invite created: "Marketplace HW/SI compliance sync" Fri 09:30. Signed URL TTLs adjustable on request.
Tom G: Noted. Will post draft questionnaire answers in the thread when ready.
Raj (HW): Will attach firmware signing procedure and sample manifest to the bucket by Apr 8.
Maya P: Thanks team let's keep the thread for updates only.
